🔄 One account or two. Where the line is.

A common question: why do Telegram and the website sometimes show different data. It comes down to which action you chose at sign-in.
There are only two actions, and the difference matters.

1. Create account. Every time you tap "Create account," the system makes a new profile with a new ID. Created on web, then separately on Telegram, that is two accounts. Created on Telegram, then separately by e-mail on the site, also two.
2. Log in / authorize. If an account already exists in Telegram and on the site you choose "Log in with Telegram," it syncs. Then:

✅ one ID
✅ one account
✅ the same data in Telegram and on web

📌 Simple rule: to stay in one profile, always choose "Log in," never "Create account."

Accounts created separately do not merge automatically and count as different profiles. For merging, contact support.
